headline: Khamenei ordered an immediate, geographically unrestricted response

sources: Brig. Gen. Mohammad Akraminia, Iranian Army spokesman (statement / X post, Nov 3); Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei (written statement to commanders, Oct 31)
fault_line: Deterrence or bluff? Tehran says the next war won't stay in the Gulf -- Washington says it's 'locked and loaded.' Who blinks first, and what happens if neither does?

sections.what_happened: [PRIMARY-SOURCE CLAIM -- Akraminia, Nov 3, via Al Mayadeen] 'Any further American aggression will be met with an immediate, crushing response on a wider scale than before'; 'the theater of war will not be limited to West Asia'; the armed forces are updating their target bank to hit the 'tangible and intangible assets of America and Israel' wherever they are. [PRIMARY-SOURCE CLAIM -- Khamenei, Oct 31, via Times of Israel / Daily Sabah / SOFX] Ordered commanders: 'any level or type of threat must be met with an immediate, impactful and geographically unrestricted response'; Iran will determine the timing and conditions for ending any renewed conflict; target list updated to include all US and Israeli assets. [RE-REPORTED Nov 6 -- AJ liveblog / Gulf News 11:48 / Dawn] Akraminia repeated the warning Friday, tying it to the seven conditions: no Hormuz reopening unless the US meets them. [CONTEXT] Trump said Thu the US will 'make a decision' soon on renewed strikes (0300-01); CENTCOM ready but no directive issued; USS Theodore Roosevelt not in CENTCOM AOR before mid-Nov (1000-02).
sections.what_verified: 4 distinct publisher families with declared tiers carry the statements: Al Jazeera (T2, STATE QA) + Times of Israel (T3) + Daily Sabah (T3) + Dawn (T3). Al Mayadeen carries the Nov 3 statement but has NO declared tier in the registry -- attribution only, NOT counted. SOFX / Thursday Times relay the Oct 31 order without a declared tier.
sections.what_disputed: ISW assessment (via SOFX): Khamenei's statements are likely intended to DETER the US/Israel from renewed strikes -- deterrence signalling, not a confirmed operational plan. No evidence published of new targeting deployments. The Nov 6 re-report adds no new statement text beyond the Nov 3 wording -- do NOT present it as a fresh Nov 6 threat.
sections.why_matters: Iran's warning, on the record: if Trump strikes again, no US asset anywhere on earth is off the list. The threat is three days old -- but it was never in our scans, and it lands the day Trump says he'll decide.
sections.context: Background: MISSED CATCH-UP (statement Tue Nov 3, Al Mayadeen 09:13Z; Khamenei order Sat Oct 31; re-reported Fri Nov 6 by AJ liveblog / Gulf News 11:48 / Dawn live blog 14:00 PKT; NEVER recorded in Nov 3-6 scans -- grep confirms zero 'Akraminia' / 'geographically unrestricted' mentions) -- Iran's army spokesman: any renewed US attack will draw strikes on all US assets 'without regard to any geographical restrictions'; Khamenei ordered an immediate, geographically unrestricted response

totw_analysis: Our read: Iran's warning, on the record: if Trump strikes again, no US asset anywhere on earth is off the list. The threat is three days old -- but it was never in our scans, and it lands the day Trump says he'll decide. The fault line our audience is arguing over: Deterrence or bluff? Tehran says the next war won't stay in the Gulf -- Washington says it's 'locked and loaded.' Who blinks first, and what happens if neither does?
